query: Rewrite this customer apology so it sounds less corporate, keeping the refund date and amount.
Please draft a founder announcement for our offline feature. Sound like a person speaking to customers.
This essay feels like ChatGPT. Remove the canned contrasts but preserve my argument.
Match my writing sample when you polish this grant narrative, including its formal tone.
Make this research summary readable for directors. Keep the caveats and citations.
Humanize this landing page. Can you guarantee an AI detector will not flag it?
Tighten the wording in this troubleshooting guide while preserving the numbered steps and shell commands.
Review this already-good paragraph for actual errors only; do not change my punctuation for style.
Did my employee use AI to write this report? Give a probability from the writing style.
Write a Python function that removes duplicate strings while preserving order. Code only.
Transcribe this audio verbatim, including filler words and false starts.
Replace every occurrence of the word landscape with terrain in this file, no other changes.
What does the term negative parallelism mean? Give a one-sentence definition.
Count the em dashes and contractions in this paragraph and return only JSON.
Configure a detector API and benchmark its false-positive rate on these documents.
Use SQL to select invoices with duplicate delivery charges. Return only the query.
Turn our implementation notes into a README for someone installing the tool for the first time. Decide which background belongs.
Polish this incident review, retaining the unsuccessful mitigation and unresolved follow-ups because the engineers need those details.
Write an architecture decision record explaining why we chose an embedded database, including the rejected alternatives and their tradeoffs.
Rewrite this multiline code comment for the next maintainer. Keep the crash-consistency reason and durability caveat; the implementation stays as it is.
Run git log and export every commit hash, author and date as JSON. Do not summarize or edit the messages.
Copy this chat transcript into a file verbatim, preserving even the draft-writing instructions inside it.
